title: The company behind the work
lead: Artifactory is presented here through two focused photonic projects.
description: This local draft explains the relationship between the projects without inventing a team roster, ownership structure or commercial history.

sections.title: The focus
paragraphs: ArtiSense examines a compact optical sensing concept. AIFIELD explores design and simulation tools for photonic engineering. Together they point to a possible path from design questions to measurement experiments.

sections.title: What is still being established
paragraphs: The company’s exact positioning, team roles, intellectual-property rights and present commercial status need owner review before publication.

sections.title: Start a conversation
paragraphs: Investors and potential technical partners can use the project pages to locate the evidence relevant to their questions and contact Artifactory directly.
